normative_dictionary.reconciliation: The current dictionary bytes and all direct-partition expressions were locally checked for this pilot against protocol commit ad77460df82764312fb701f6be4ebf7eb5051c41. The older dictionary creation provenance is retained; no dictionary or protocol semantic change was made.

translation_status.reason: A visible Advanced Search multi-row control became unavailable while constructing BG2-C2. Per the access/control failure rule, source interaction stopped; several cells remain untested.

source_native_implementation.classification: normal rendered arXiv Advanced Search UI
source_native_implementation.field_scope: Every query row selects the visible All fields control (value all).
source_native_implementation.query_file_format: Each UTF-8 query file is an ordered, BOM-free, LF-terminated sequence of visible form assignments: terms-N-operator, terms-N-field, and terms-N-term. It is not an API request, a saved-search URL, or a static route.
source_native_implementation.query_file_hash_scope: SHA-256 covers all file bytes, including exactly one terminal LF.
source_native_implementation.row_grammar: Within a row, finite alternatives are joined by the observed literal OR token. Rows are joined by the visible AND operator. No final translation relies on raw nested parentheses or raw mixed AND/OR precedence inside one All fields row.

raw_single_row_limitation.statement: Simple raw AND and OR were accepted in one All fields row, but tested parenthesized/mixed expressions did not demonstrate reliable grouping; a right-grouped test returned the same total as the left-associated form. The translations therefore use visible rows for top-level conjunction rather than raw nested grouping.

source_native_implementation.pair_rule_implementation: For direct-search recall cells, a dictionary pair is implemented as left alternatives in one All fields row AND right alternatives in another All fields row. This is same-record Boolean co-occurrence, not a validated proximity assertion; it retains every finite left/right alternative and does not add a proximity operator.

pilot_date_controls.limitation: P-001 has not set the common upper cutoff. The pilot did not invent one or claim exact final-day handling.

source_native_implementation.future_date_rule: Do not use a source-side upper Submission date (most recent) filter for the final run: it can exclude a report submitted before the cutoff but revised after it. Use unbounded discovery, preserve every returned stable base ID, obtain the visible submission history/version dates for each report, determine the earliest version containing a substantial completed report locally, and use only versions available by the P-001 cutoff for later eligibility/extraction. The visible original-date option is not enough to establish the substantial-version rule.
source_native_implementation.language_rule: No native English restriction is applied. Full-report language remains a later screening determination.

no_silent_narrowing.population: All ten finite P terms are retained in every cell that requires P. SmallSat and small satellite are absent. nanosat* is not used despite a bounded equal-total comparison because stable-ID set equality was not tested.
no_silent_narrowing.logical_relations: Each partition preserves the dictionary AND/OR relation through visible AND rows, finite OR lists, and the declared lossless union of cells.
no_silent_narrowing.dates: No common cutoff is embedded in query files; P-001 remains unresolved. No unsupported upper-bound substitution is permitted.
no_silent_narrowing.failed_or_unexecuted_cells: A failed, blocked, or untested cell cannot be dropped, narrowed, treated as zero, or substituted with a different query. Its whole partition remains incomplete with total null for final-event purposes.
no_silent_narrowing.pair_rules: No unvalidated proximity, wildcard, stemming, automatic expansion, or source-specific synonym is introduced.

final_preflight_requirements: P-001 must set the common cutoff before any final event.
A human operator must reproduce the visible multi-row control sequence, including the previously unavailable second Add another term action, before any final source interaction.
Revalidate every exact cell with final controls and record source total/explicit zero or total null; complete every cell of a lossless union.
Use unbounded discovery with complete base-ID/version-history/date handling for the final upper cutoff rule.
Require two complete page/range/base-ID passes for each successful cell and reject any changed total, short/stale page, duplicate/missing ID, failed history capture, or control drift.
